causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Despite being a Sunday, demand was high, exceeding 8000 MW from 4 pm and reaching 8204 MW at 5.30 pm.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: the key underlying driver was supply conditions brought about by participant rebidding (sometimes late in the trading interval).

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Terranora has been partially out of service since August 2013 due to faulty cables, which has reduced its maximum import limit to around 30 MW.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Callide Power Trading's Callide C unit 3 was ramp up constrained.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Imports across the Queensland to New South Wales interconnector (QNI) were limited to around 200 MW by a system normal constraint.

constraints_named.quote: output at ERM Power's Oakey Power station was limited during the high price periods by a system normal constraint (Q>NIL_MRTA_A, designed to prevent the thermal overload of a Middle Ridge to Tangkam 110 kV line for the trip of the parallel line).

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland to New South Wales interconnector (QNI)
interconnectors_named.quote: Imports across the Queensland to New South Wales interconnector (QNI) were limited to around 200 MW by a system normal constraint.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows into Queensland across the Terranora interconnector were limited to 10 MW during the time of high prices.

intervals.quote: the dispatch price reached the market price cap of $13,500/MWh at 4.25 pm, 4.35 pm, 4.45 pm, 4.55 pm, 8 pm and 9 pm in Queensland. The spot price reached $6626 MWh at 5 pm as a result of the dispatch prices at 4.35 pm, 4.45 pm and 4.55 pm.
